neverReadBy: any product, board, recommendation or official snapshot — the Theater only, labelled as a research simulation

selectionRules.pool: runIndex 0 … poolSize − 1 of the engine's fixed seed policy (seed = hash(providerEventId); draw i uses mulberry32(fnv1a32(seed + ':' + i)))
selectionRules.distance: official-representative@2 distance to the official v0.1 player expectations (team terms withheld for NBA)
selectionRules.default: smallest distance among runs won by the official Elo favoured side; ties → lowest runIndex
selectionRules.upset: smallest distance among runs won by the side the official forecast does not favour; ties → lowest runIndex
selectionRules.high: total closest to the pool's p90 total (nearest rank); ties → smaller distance → lowest runIndex
selectionRules.low: total closest to the pool's p10 total (nearest rank); ties → smaller distance → lowest runIndex
selectionRules.overtime: smallest distance among overtime runs; ties → lowest runIndex (only when the pool has one)
selectionRules.order: default, upset, high, low, overtime — each pick excludes the runs already picked

v1Receipt.profileRebuild: NOT_REPLAYED: no v1 game for this event; sides rebuilt at the freeze from the official receipt's input blobs

withheld.winProbability: Not shown: no NBA game-outcome chance has been validated (0 graded regular-season games).
withheld.teamScores: Not shown: this model's team score is a sum of player simulations that ignores the opponent, can contradict the Elo side, and has not met its historical checks.
withheld.playerRanges: Medians only: the model's ranges have not yet shown reliable coverage.
withheld.markets: No sportsbook prices, lines, edges, picks or rankings: there is no authorized NBA price, and these figures are not betting recommendations.

game.seedPolicy: fixed-per-game: hash(providerEventId); draw i uses mulberry32(fnv1a32(seed + ':' + i))
